sub_answers.text: Diana Fosha promotes therapeutic models that integrate relevant neurobiological processes, including implicit memory and cognitive, emotional and sensorimotor processing [d72248675s19p0]. Ricky Greenwald applies eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR) and founded the Trauma Institute & Child Trauma Institute [d72248675s19p0]. Anna Baranowsky developed the Traumatology Institute and focuses on secondary trauma and effective PTSD techniques [d72248675s19p0]. Lady Edwina Grosvenor promotes a trauma-informed approach in women's prisons in the United Kingdom [d72248675s19p0]. SAMHSA's trauma-informed care framework (three E's; four R's; six key principles; ten implementation domains) is a widely cited TIC model referenced for implementation in organizations and policy contexts [d72248675s3p0].
